name: TimeRangeSelector
description: Segmented control for the broker-status window: 1m / 5m / 15m / 60m presets plus a custom interval (value and unit, capped at one day) in a dropdown; emits a legacy `change` event with the selected minutes.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected window in minutes. May be fractional (30 seconds is 0.5) and may sit outside `options` when the custom interval is in use.

props.name: options
props.description: Preset windows offered as segments, in minutes.

props.name: sparseNote
props.description: Optional tooltip on the group explaining sparse broker series at short ranges. Nothing is ever disabled.

notes: Emits on:change (legacy createEventDispatcher) with the selected minutes as detail. The custom segment is the selected-looking one whenever `value` is not a preset, and it is labelled with the live interval ("2h") instead of "Custom". Custom edits debounce at 400 ms and commit on Enter, blur or a unit click; the window is clamped to one day, which is all the broker-status store retains. Parse, clamp and label rules live in the colocated time-range.ts, which shares its unit vocabulary with the chart's chart-custom-window.ts.
